fact: Specific if-then plans increase exercise adherence by 2-3x compared to vague goals
practical_application: Write workout days/times as specific if-then statements in calendar

fact: If-then plans work by automating initiation, bypassing willpower
practical_application: Automate the getting-there decision

fact: Coping plans add 20-30% adherence on top of if-then plans
practical_application: Pre-plan for top 3 excuses

fact: Habits form through repetition in consistent contexts, not motivation
practical_application: Focus on showing up consistently

fact: Average 66 days to automaticity (range 18-254); exercise takes 90+ days
practical_application: Commit to 90 days minimum

fact: Habit stacking — anchoring new behavior to existing routine — is more effective than isolated habits
practical_application: After work at 5PM, drive directly to gym

fact: Environment design (reducing friction) beats willpower
practical_application: Pack gym bag nightly, keep shoes by door

fact: Identity-based habits outperform outcome-based goals for long-term adherence
practical_application: Shift to 'I am a lifter' identity

fact: Small consistent actions reinforce identity more than large sporadic efforts
practical_application: Never miss twice; even bad workouts count

fact: People consume 200-400 extra calories on weekends and are 30-40% less active
practical_application: Plan weekends as carefully as weekdays

fact: The 'what the hell' effect causes overeating after a single diet violation
practical_application: Return to plan at next meal immediately

fact: Motivation predictably drops at Weeks 3-4, Month 3, and Month 6
practical_application: Pre-commit to pushing through known drop points

fact: 50% of new exercisers drop out within first 6 weeks
practical_application: Survive the first 6 weeks at all costs

fact: Social accountability doubles adherence rates
practical_application: Tell someone your plan, post workouts

fact: Self-monitoring increases adherence 20-50%; track multiple metrics not just weight
practical_application: Track strength, photos, fit of clothes — not just scale

fact: Online fitness communities provide measurable adherence benefit
practical_application: Join r/Fitness or a Discord server

fact: Gym partner slightly more consistent than you provides optimal motivation
practical_application: Find someone who consistently shows up

fact: Minimum viable workout concept reduces missed sessions dramatically
practical_application: Define your minimum: 2 sets of push-ups on bad days

fact: Reframing discomfort as growth data improves tolerance
practical_application: Think 'this is what growth feels like'

fact: Process goals outperform outcome goals for adherence
practical_application: Set weekly process goals: sessions completed, protein hit

fact: Never miss twice — the strongest single predictor of long-term success
practical_application: Missed session = next session is mandatory

fact: 2-minute rule: reducing starting requirement to 2 minutes dramatically increases follow-through
practical_application: Just get to the gym and do ONE set — you'll stay
